It has to do with the three prophesies, and we're going to use the antlers to understand the prophesies. The light shines purple (same purple as the Alabaster seat).

Tell the Elk that we're not going to harm it, and we just want to use

Talking about the verses:

We took the prophesies, with Ruth and Sheila, to a magic giant elk, and used his antlers to answer some questions about them. Every time we got something right, the papers or words would light up.

First Prophecy:

This was heard from Ruth in Argos

The anchors fall, the realms sunder

Hearts of stone gathered from plunder

Death incarnate knocks at the door

Below the blood star begins the final war

The anchors fall refers to something that is with each of the Zeniths and as they fall, the realms will fall into chaos.

Hearts of Stone: We’ve seen a heart of stone, the Heart of the Wilde, plus the other slots in the tower of the Red Tunic Brigade. We also know from Tiberious that this stone has been stolen and “gathered from plunder”

The Blood Star: One was seen before when Tygras came to power. It’s a star that’ll turn red and literally fall. Meteorite (?)

The Final War: refers to Gard’damon (Anagram for Armeggedon)

Second Prophecy:

This was heard from the hags

Double bubble toil and trouble,

Gard'damon is neigh, the first zenith is rubble,

Prepare the Pestilence with Children's souls,

The husks remain until they're told.

Double bubble toil and trouble,

Anchors lifted and hearts are smuggled.

The first zenith: Always refers to the Forest Zenith. We’re not quite sure how its rubble.

Pestilence: What happened to it? We tried to get rid of it but couldn’t, so we demolished a building on top of it. We’ve also seen it in other places.

The husks: The bodies of the children who’s souls were taken.

Anchors: being lifted from the Zeniths

Hearts are Smuggled: We know of a smuggler in Argos: Lord Jerefor.

Third Prophecy:

This was heard from Mia after we rescued her.

As the rains falls on the fallow harvest, and the matrim pact fulfilled,

The Anchor of Famine shall be lifted, the echo of TYGRAS stilled.

As the snow drifts over the ruined tribe, and serpent plagues the sea

The Anchor of Pestilence shall awake, to answer the curator's plea

As the fire bellows on the forgotten forge, and the blood star is found

The Anchor of War shall be silenced, as the new paragon is crowned.

As the sunlight warms the forest gate, and madness prisoner freed

The Anchor of Death shall sway, to bring peace to star-crossed three.

The four horseman: Famine, Pestilence, War and Death are universally known as bringers of the apocalypse, of Armageddon.

Locations: the four verses refer to four points on a map

The map we saw on the Thornberry Shade bubbled up in five places:(1) Var’taos ruins, also known as The Valley of Anchors, the origin of magic, (2) Vagna Har - The dwarven city, (3) Macchu, (4) Bynar, (5) Tygras Logra - This point additionally had a burning ember on its location.

In order, the verses refer to: (1) Tygras Logar, (2) Bynar, (3) Vagna Har and (4) Macchu.

Matrim Pact: Gnomes, Humans and Half-elfs created a utopia on the back of the turtle Mia. We know of a qualashahar that has more information about this.

Tygras: The last threat to this universe. <need more information on the specifics here>

Serpent Sea: Literally the north sea. And it has a serpent. We know of someone, Dilbert, who has fought the serpent.

Ruined Tribe: We know that there is a ruined tribe in Bynar (Dragon-kin history check)

Winter’s Curators: We know that the dragon kin tribe in Bynar is known as these.

Forgotten Forge: A forge in dwarven legend. It has to be lit once again. This falls into place with a few of our backstories and answers about our futures.

Blood Star is found: Found does not mean rise.

Paragon: The Bronze beards, the rulers of Vagna Har.

Forest and Sunlight: Finkle will have more information about this.

Madness Prisoner: Mordred and his phylactery.

Star-crossed three: Sabine, Mordred and Xeres. Once we bring their souls/phylacteries to the forest, and complete the trial of the zenith, we will bring peace to them.

The tale of the Last Curator

Once upon a time, all of the gods existed on the same plane. In this plane there was war, for no god was worthy of owning a plane itself. There was one type of creature that was able to withstand the gods wrath - the curators. They gathered the god's creation and created a flower. All petals (planes) are branches of the flower. We live in the god of the Raven Queen, the opposite of Veccna, the greediest, most destructor of all. More lore!

There are 12 mag har including the bronze beard. Bartrim points to a pillar behind him where there is a set of armor - an axe, a breast plate, shield sword, shoulder pieces, pants, etc, and a large gear on the chest and a belt with red ruby gems in it. There's a number of gems lit up -

All but the hammer, sword, helm, clockwork and belt are activated. With every push of the bellows, the symbols light up. Bartrim is the breast plate and Daina's father is the axe.

This is the castle of the hammer! And once we free that phoenix, your hammer, or whoever is still alive and made it (Bergs' mother) will light up.

Ifrin will owe Bergs big time. He'll be in the forge.

Bergs will lend you the service of his hammer, if we get the axe back as well.

Ifrin takes the hammer and smacks the image of the pieces. All the ice begin cracking as a beast falls into the lava - a bird of fire emerges. It circles around the building a begins to melt the star. Fire begins to fall and pool as the lava begins to rise.

Barden has a symbol of a shoe on his foot - being the fireforged.

The duregard (passing the flame) step in and are emulated immediately

The dreadnought is gone from the lava, but its shields remain.

The castle fills with lava and then goes down once again.

Ifrin allows everyone into the castle now.

Dvinter fortress is over, but you are welcome to enter.

More questions.

There were 12 Mag Har in the beginning. Have you heard of Ladeger. Long ago the Duregard were part of the dwarven clans. They were considered lower class from the rest of us. And when the mind flayers came, they were the first to fall. They were enslaved, and their greed caused them to go further down. Ladegar was the first to break the mind-flayer's bond. He made a deal with Osmodius, and this pact led to the creation of Tiefling. The two were able to fight back and establish these fortresses. They hold the mind flayers back.

Once the 12 gathered beneath what is now Vag Mahar, and they created a being incapable of being corrupted by the mind flayers. The war forged. They were driven back and safety was brought to all. The duregard were ostracized unfortunately. Knowledge was passed from generation to generation and the fire forged were born. Because they put their souls into their weapons, they needed a way to revitalize themselves - the bath in the lava. To gain your mark, you must activate a fortress, or you must inherit it and the apprentice then becomes the master. Additionally, there are only 2 fireforged per symbol at a time - a master and an apprentice.

Bergs' master is his mother. The soul is fading. And now the bond can last a little longer. There might be one that can help you find her in the Vag Mahar - Deaconsmith Runner.

Apprentices have to be born, it's a familial thing.

Unfinished business with the Aboleth.

To truly kill an abolith you must kill it here, and then travel to the elemental water plane and kill it there. Ifrin can travel there and kill it while it's still weak.

Additionally, Ifrin has business there because the 9 realms of hell collapsed.

Ifrin doesn't really concern himself with our current troubles, he's more concerned about the elemental plane.

LONG REST

We actually end up chilling for 10 hours in this castle.

Everyone is walking around, doing things. Daina and Yusef looks through a portal and ends up seeing where the first forge is. Guarded by a fire Cthulu. They're going to have to find the 13th temple, and some kind of blood star. He doesn't know the dragon.

But she doesn't know what he's hiding. He's hiding something though.

While asleep, Irethia gets flashes of a great war. She also sees herself on the battlefield in the war. Locked in battle with a devil, she sees a man with a tophat - Renaldine. It takes both pendants and puts them together. Irethia's wings fail and the devils fade, and she's in a forest.

She's remembering that Renaldine broke everything, and as such is more than an arch-fey.

Nocturnous reaches forward with Nightmare and plucks out Finn's eye in a trade for a spider companion. There's a dark void, and his eyebrows are gone.

And ends up not trading anything.

Finn tries to take the sword from Nocturnous, and no one has moved as fast as Nocturnous moves. He scratches Finn and leaves some marks.

And sleep.

## Chapter 38X (Nyx's Notes)
**Chapter 38X - Nyx_s notes - Euclid_s Study(1)**

Notes from Chapter 38X – Euclid’s Study

(These were relayed from Nyx and Stalwart)

Suddenly, Stalwart and Nyx are pulled through a portal!

It's different from our normal portals, more jarring.

They also see visions of an owl. Linda's mimicking, and Hedwig is nowhere to be found

They land!

And are greeted by an owl humanoid creature amongst a pile of books.

Apparently he only wanted one of them.

They're in a huge library, glowing blue somehow.

Behind the owl is a window blinking yellow-white and from there, a huge voice telling Euclid to calm down, and Inchu has asked their help to reclaim the Sunless Citadel - they need to clear out the snakes

Euclid calls this voice Archimedes, and says Nyx (the Tome-Sworn) is on thin ice.

Euclid was the keeper of the Divine Seal, but he is no longer.

His enemy is also Reynaldine of the Autumn Court.

Reynaldine

Apparently his powers are not entirely his own

He was once a Prince of Harvest

Now, he's the Ruler of the Feywilde West of the Glittering Run

And those under the Queen of Thorns call him an Abomination.

Be careful though, we might not want this information - for knowledge is power.

He might not know, but he'll know that Euclid talked to Nyx.

All the Lore!

7 heavens were ruled by 3 entities: Barachiel the Just, Dominel the Righteous and Gabriel the Kind. They were gifted domain of at least one celestial plane.

Prime: Gabriel.

9 Hells - Lords of the Nine and the Princes of the Abyss. And they had a blood war over it and Asmodeus's seals.

Nobody thankfully is stupid enough to release him.

Conflict:

2 fated betrothed in love with beings above them.

Reynaldine and Juliannia Princess of the Summer Solstice

Gabriel the Rind and Graz'zt.

Juliannia was bewitched by Graz'zt, and elevated the Ambitious Devil into a demon, Juliannia becoming his Demon Amulet.

Graz'zt became the Demon Prince the Lord of Pleasure.

Gabriel condensed himself and the Demon Prince into Graz'zt's Demonic Amulet

Reynaldine took the amulet, twisting himself.

He was never forgiven by most, especially the Queen of Thorns, Evelyandrin of the Spring Court, sister of Juliannia.

And yes, it was Reynaldine's fault. He snuck off to meet with Gabriel and caused Juliannia to search for him.

Present time

Reynaldine took Gabriel's Divine Seal and caused the collapse of the Celestial Realm, and further collapsed the 9 Hells.

They aren't gone, but they've merged into the FeyWilde.

Most citizens are held captive in a ruined human city in the feywilde

ALSO His Origins of Genasi book is missing.

Why us?

Not sure.

But! Reynaldine may have 4 pacts within his 4 selves. Nyx's pact may be with Juliannia.

Also, Reynaldine did make the pact with Tygras that began this whole Tiefling nonsense (probably Graz'zt)

Nyx's sister, Xyn, might have a pact with Gabriel

And Reynaldine himself might be saving his pact.

The Queen of Thorns is within the Feywilde, her kingdom almost gone as the Autumn Court's forces have pushed them into the briar patch

Do not mention the theatre, her sister. AND NO RED.

The goblin tribes were lured and sacrificed to the great serpent, but there should be a few outliers about.

Goals!

Euclid believes it possible to bring Juliannia back with Gabriel. But we'll need Xyn and Tygras, and Reynaldine's pactbound.
